title: Putnami Typed Per-Verb Payloads (v1)
description: Canonical payloads verb jobs carry inside generic runtime events: test/coverage/lint summaries, per-test cases and the Distribution-owned release-set outcome in result data, publish records in artifact extras. Producers may add fields; consumers must ignore unknown ones.

ReleaseSetPublishOutcome.description: The sole successful distribution/release-set/v2 publish outcome, carried under result data.releaseSet. Its fields are owned only by the Distribution protocol.

TestSummary.description: Test outcome, carried in result data under 'testSummary'.

failureDetailsTruncated.description: Causal failure diagnostics omitted by the bounded presentation profile. The complete transcript remains in log events.

TestCases.description: One entry per test case a test job ran, carried in result data under 'testCases' beside 'testSummary'. The entry shape and its bounds, including the per-task cap (testCaseMaxPerTask), are owned by the CLI result contract and not restated here: the CLI writes each entry as one test:case session-stream record. A runtime without structured per-case output omits the member.

TestCasesDropped.description: How many test cases the job left out of 'testCases' to respect its bounds, carried in result data under 'testCasesDropped'. Present only when the job left cases out.

CoverageSummary.description: Coverage outcome, carried in result data under 'coverageSummary'. Percentage at a declared granularity; languages measure differently (Go: statements, TypeScript: lines), so consumers must not mix counts across granularities.

LintSummary.description: Lint outcome, carried in result data under 'lintSummary'. Individual findings travel as per-issue diagnostic events; a single aggregate diagnostic of raw tool output is not conformant.

PublishRecord.description: Published-artifact metadata, carried as extra top-level fields on a kind='published' artifact event.
